note: Base rates of Certificados de Aforro published by IGCP, gross, in % per year, by the month they are in force. "official" rates were read on an IGCP page or table; "derived" ones follow by arithmetic from official figures. A month that is not here has no known rate: April 2025 is left out because its rate was found on a news site only, and no official monthly rate was found before December 2024. Add a month by adding its line; the estimate of a certificate stops at the first quarter whose month is missing.
